observation: Two unique completed GUT contamination-triage receipts scoped to the same contested parent, carrying the same supported triage classification but different canonical provenance, were previously placed on HOLD because dynamic decomposition treated classification+provenance as one conflict signature.
qualityRisk: Distinct provenance is evidence-significant and must remain visible, but provenance diversity alone does not imply classification disagreement. Treating it as a conflict blocked an otherwise identical bounded decomposition profile and made downstream behavior depend on provenance identity rather than on the metabolic diagnosis that is supposed to regulate VAJRA.
resolution: Target qualification guard v0.3 now separates classification agreement from provenance identity. Multiple unique qualifying receipts scoped to the same contested parent may select one already-bounded decomposition profile only when all supported classifications agree. Distinct provenance remains fingerprint-audited and is explicitly not promoted to an independence claim. Any classification disagreement still HOLDs with zero facets.
verifiedGates: same classification + distinct canonical provenance => same bounded profile
classification disagreement => HOLD with zero facets
replays do not inflate receipt counts
distinct provenance remains auditable without asserting independence
cross-organ GUT and VAJRA regressions pass
privacy: Synthetic de-identified evidence only; no private connector content, names, IDs, or URLs are stored.
